episodes.title: Dar Dixon: Escaping a Doomsday Cult and Finding His Way in Hollywood | Celebrity Interview
episodes.description:
Actor Dar Dixon joins The Staffa Corner Podcast to share a life story that stretches from leaving Iran before the revolution to surviving a doomsday cult and building a career in Hollywood. In a candid conversation, Dar explains how manipulation draws people in gradually, and why intelligence offers no guarantee against it.


Dar also reflects on rebuilding his life, navigating Hollywood’s casting expectations, and confronting his past through the HBO docuseries Bring Me the Beauties and his upcoming memoir, The Walk-In. With humor and honesty, he shares what recovery taught him about identity, vulnerability, and finding peace with his own story.
